_about: English: the default text, the same words the components carry in their code. A test keeps this file equal to them.
ach.notEnoughData: Not enough data yet on this achievement.
confirm.skip: Don't ask me again for this
save.chooserHeading: Your account already has saves for this game. Where should this one go?
save.claim: Claim this save to your account
save.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — code is shown above.
save.freshCode: Next save starts a fresh code.
save.loadBadCode: Load failed — check the code (format XXXX-XXXX) and try again.
save.loadOffline: Load failed — you appear to be offline.
save.newSave: Start a new save (forget this code)
save.newSaveConfirm: Start a new save? This forgets your current save code in this browser -- your progress under that code isn't deleted from the server and can still be loaded later by pasting the code back in, but you'll need to have saved it somewhere first. This browser won't remember it anymore.
save.noSnapshots: No earlier states yet. One is kept before a load or a new game, and while autosave is on.
save.notWiredLoad: This game hasn't wired up loading yet.
save.notWiredSave: This game hasn't wired up saving yet.
save.otherAccount: That save already belongs to another account.
save.overwriteConfirm: Overwrite slot {n} ({name}, {ago}) with your current progress? The old save in that slot is replaced.
save.restoreConfirm: Restore the state from {when} ({summary})? Your current progress is snapshotted first, so you can undo this from the same list.
save.restored: Restored. Your previous state is first in the list, so you can undo this.
save.savesUnreachable: Couldn't reach your saves just now — try again.
save.signInExpired: Your sign-in has expired — sign in again from the hub.
save.slotsFull: All 3 save slots are full — use "Save here" on a slot to replace one instead.
save.snapshotFetchFailed: Couldn't fetch that snapshot — try again.
save.snapshotsUnreachable: Couldn't reach your account's snapshots, so this lists the ones in this browser.
save.stillLoading: Still loading — try again in a moment.
save.warning: Warning: the last save did not go through. Press Save Progress to try again.
share.pressCopy: Press Ctrl+C (or ⌘C) to copy the selected text.
